title: Core container ops: Sort, Quick Stack, Restock, Deposit All, Loot All (favourite-aware), Quick Stack to Nearby Chests, persistent chest names
player_outcome:
Chests get Terraria's buttons:
- Loot All, Deposit All, Quick Stack, Restock and Sort Items.
- Rename, with the name kept in the save.

The inventory's 'Quick stack to nearby chests' sends matching items into every chest around you, and favourited items never move.
design:
New src/Strata.Core/Gameplay/Items/InventoryOps.cs:
- `LootAll(Inventory chest, PlayerInventory inv)`: coins go to the purse.
- `DepositAll(PlayerInventory, Inventory chest)`: skips the hotbar, favourites and coins.
- `QuickStack(PlayerInventory, Inventory chest)`: moves only non-favourite backpack stacks (slots 10..49) whose item already exists in the chest, merging first.
- `Restock(Inventory chest, PlayerInventory)`: tops up stackable backpack stacks from the chest.
- `Sort(Inventory inv, int from, int to)`: merges partial stacks, then orders by category group (weapons, tools, armor/accessories, potions, placeables, materials, misc), rarity descending, then id. Favourited stacks keep their slots.
- `SortChest(Inventory)`.

In GameWorld.InventoryActions.cs, add `QuickStackNearby(PlayerEntity p, float radiusM = 12f)`:
- Scans `Session.World.TileObjects.InBox(box)` for objects with a Container.
- Calls `Editor.EnsureContainerLoot(obj)` first, then QuickStack.
- Marks the chunk modified.
- Returns `List<(TileObjectInstance, int moved)>` so the UI can later show items flying.

Chest names:
- `TileObjectInstance.CustomName` (string?, at most 20 printable characters).
- ChunkCodec.WriteObjects sets state bit 4 and writes the name after PendingLoot; ReadObjects reads it only when bit 4 is set, so older chunks read unchanged and FormatVersion stays 1.
- `GameWorld.RenameContainer(TileObjectInstance, string)` trims and sanitises, marks the chunk modified, and calls Interaction.NotifyChanged.

Extend InventoryCommands: `chest <loot|deposit|quickstack|restock|sort|rename <name>>` acting on the container last opened by the player (ObjectInteraction.ContainerOpened), `invsort` and `quickstack`.
tests:
InventoryOpsTests:
- SortMergesStacksAndKeepsFavoritesInPlace.
- QuickStackOnlyMovesItemsAlreadyInChest.
- RestockTopsUpBackpackStacks.
- DepositAllSkipsHotbarCoinsAndFavorites.
- LootAllRoutesCoinsToCoinSlots.
- QuickStackNearbyReachesChestsInRangeOnly: TestGame places wooden_chest at 5 m and at 30 m.

ui.cmds: `place wooden_chest 0 0 -3` / `interact 0 0 -3` / `give wood 30` / `chest deposit` / `assert inv.wood == 0` / `chest loot` / `assert inv.wood == 30` / `chest rename Loot` / `assert errors == 0`
verification: dotnet test; headless ui.cmds SMOKE PASS
Save the world, reload it, reopen the chest: the name is kept
risks: Locked dungeon chests (a P4 bosses/dungeon item) must be excluded from QuickStackNearby once they exist. Leave a `Locked` check hook on TileObjectInstance for P4 to fill.
Chunk-dirty marking must not force urgent remeshes (a D lag item). Use MarkModified only.
